label: Process Improvement and Documentation Team
blurb: A Process Improvement Lead and 4 specialists who improve repeatable workflows and document how they should run
purpose: Designed for business owners, leaders, and teams executing on process improvement and documentation. Improve repeatable workflows and document how they should run. The team coordinates research, analysis, operational planning, and structured deliverables to drive measurable results.
